subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Gateway-owned cron lifecycle management as a core experimental Claws capability, and land this slice after its open export prerequisite?
rationale: The patch introduces a new persisted core lifecycle and scheduler-management surface; correctness of the implementation does not by itself establish that this experimental product direction and stacked landing sequence are desired.

options.title: Sponsor and stage the slice
options.body: Accept the experimental core direction, land the prerequisite first, and require real-Gateway lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the direction in RFC/design review
options.body: Defer landing until maintainers decide whether grouped Claw lifecycle ownership belongs in core rather than an external extension surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and stage the slice
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental core direction, land the prerequisite first, and require real-Gateway lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has already reviewed the scheduler ownership and deletion-lifecycle invariants.
